text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Yukino Bijin! She has dyed 
the cherry-blossom-filled Hanshin 
Racecourse in pure snow white...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! I... I won. I was able to win...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was able to wear it! The sparkle of the 
tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chan... Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Your radiance is... so pure and dazzling.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Phew...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...I have to go back...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight returned looking visibly 
unsteady on her feet. The color drained 
from my face in an instant, but...
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're not hurt?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's true! Teacher said so too, 
didn't they?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I seem to have pushed past 
my limits... I'm sorry for making you 
worry.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...I lost. Yukino-chan's radiance is... 
truly beautiful.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Even so... I'm so glad I got to run today!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I figured out the secret behind the 
brilliance of the Tiara route girls."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They are dressed in classic, royal-road 
coordinates. Their cuteness is the very 
radiance of a tiara.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I want to wear an outfit like that too... 
One that makes my heart flutter!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"By the time the Shuka Sho comes, I'm sure 
I'll be able to give it even more of my 
all."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"How will someone like me be able to 
shine...? I can't wait to find out!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, North Flight's passion for the 
Shuka Sho grew by yet another notch.
